reviews.title: Simply the best
reviews.comment: Worked perfectly as an in-place upgrade to my older noctua NH-U14S CPU cooler (get the mounting clips from Noctua first).
reviews.author: Solomon

reviews.title: Simply the best
reviews.comment: I'm actually just installing it that fan today. But every fan I have on my tower is a Noctua and I haven't had any complaints. They are well built, quiet, high performance, and efficient, excellent cooling, and the outlasted both my motherboard and my PCU.
reviews.author: MemorialParker

reviews.comment: Buena calidad. Se nota la disminución de ruido y las temperaturas disminuyeron bastante.
reviews.author: Lisandro Curin Pinto

reviews.title: Efficient fan, quite
reviews.comment: Very efficient cooling fan. Built with care and good materials. Best there is
reviews.author: ReviewedHonestlyToHelpYouDecide

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.comment: As usual Noctua does not disappoint. Not cheap but you get what you pay for. I'm using two of them in a push application bringing air in from the front of the case. The only thing I would have liked is the availability in black as I can see them through the front grill. Not ideal but I need all the air flow I can get to cool the i7 14700 boosted CPU.
reviews.author: Doru Nica
